name: ThemeColor
description: Represents a color in the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.
example:
Dim tcsThemeColorScheme As ThemeColorScheme
Dim tcThemeColor As ThemeColor
Set tcThemeColor = tcsThemeColorScheme.Colors(msoThemeAccent1)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ThemeColor object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ThemeColor object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: RGB
properties.description: Gets or sets a value of a color in the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ThemeColor object. Read-only.

properties.name: ThemeColorSchemeIndex
properties.description: Gets the index value a color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme. Read-only.
